name: bluesky
description: Post a copy of each new post to your Bluesky account, linked back to your site
author: Symbiosis Lab

settings.label: Handle
settings.description: Your Bluesky handle, such as alex.bsky.social or your own domain.

settings.label: App password
settings.description: Made in Bluesky under Settings, Privacy and security, App passwords. It can post but not change your account.

settings.label: Server
settings.description: The server your account lives on. Leave it as it is unless you run your own.
